basic_info.description: Charming well-maintained home in the desirable Crocker Amazon neighborhood of San Francisco. Featuring 3 good sized bedrooms and 1 full bath with a classic architectural details like hardwood floors and a traditional fireplace exudes a timeless character. A welcoming space in the living room and generously sized kitchen offers ample room for casual dining. Flexible floor plan allows for potential modern updates. Outside, the sizable backyard perfect for gardening or hosting guests. One car garage parking for secure parking or extra storage space. Located just minutes away from Crocker Amazon Park, shops and eateries along Mission St and Geneva Ave, and easy access to public transportation. With traditional charm and much potential in a prime location, this home is ready to welcome you.
